## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at Place du Panthéon.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Panthéon and Basilica of Saint-Denis now serve as the final resting places of some of France's most important figures. Inside the Basilica of Saint-Denis, royalty still reigns, and their magnificent tombs mirror the might they held in their lives.
>
> Beneath the intricately designed domes of the Panthéon, heroes of the French Republic reside. Literary greats like Victor Hugo shared the space with philosophers like Rousseau and Voltaire in a neoclassical building that rivals St. Peter's Basilica.
>
> With this ticket, you can get access to both of these must-sees, as well as benefit from priority entrance.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.19. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 149 ratings and 68 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
